events.description: Machina Records presents "Circuit" — the first edition of their label party in Miami. Joining him is SAY3, a Liberian/Haitian DJ and early adopter of the Batida sound. Featured on Club Djembe alongside DJ Lycox, he's no stranger to the sonic palette of this Angolan sound. Solmates Season Opener Ft. Fahlberg, Orsay & More
events.description: Solmates brings together two European producers whose work meets at the intersection of melody, groove, and late-night dance music. Built around a shared appreciation for emotional, forward-thinking electronic music, Solmates creates a space where established sounds and new perspectives can meet on the dancefloor. Stockholm-born Fahlberg has built his sound around deep basslines, hypnotic textures, and what he describes as “Nordic Melodic” — a Scandinavian sense of atmosphere shaped through contemporary house and techno. His releases have appeared on labels including Diynamic, Watergate, Siamese, MoBlack, and When Stars Align, with support from Solomun, Keinemusik, Black Coffee, and Pete Tong. Tracks such as “Somebody” and “Chaka” have reached major Beatport chart positions, while recent work includes collaborations with Layer J, Argødes, and Jeremy Olander, alongside an official remix for RÜFÜS DU SOL. Joining him is Paris- and London-based Orsay, a producer whose melodic house sound is informed by an early classical background. Having studied piano from the age of six and trained at a music conservatory, Orsay brings that foundation into productions built around rhythm, emotion, and melody. His music has been released through Ninja Tune, Siamese, Universal Music, and Kitsuné, with tracks including “Mind Off,” “Amado,” and “Magik” receiving support from Adriatique, Solomun, WhoMadeWho, Carlita, and RÜFÜS DU SOL. In 2025, he took his sets across Europe, the UAE, and South America. Together, Fahlberg and Orsay represent the sound and spirit behind Solmates: a meeting point for artists and audiences drawn to melodic, groove-led electronic music, with a focus on connection, discovery, and the energy of the night. Rooted in Europe but looking outward, Solmates brings together different musical backgrounds and perspectives under one shared atmosphere — where melody meets movement and the right records create lasting moments. 21+ event

events.description: Rescheduled Date / Refund Requests: Due to unforeseen circumstances, unfortunately Paloma Morphy has had to postpone her upcoming tour and the originally-scheduled September 30, 2026 tour date @ ZeyZey has been rescheduled to May 12, 2027 @ ZeyZey. If you are unable to attend the rescheduled date, current ticket holders have 7 days to request a refund via the form linked below. The refund request period closes Tues, Sept 22, 11:59pm. If you'd like to request a refund, please fill out the below form in full and refunds will be processed as they are received. Please allow a few business days for the refund to hit your account. https://forms.gle/nrUYem5EqBQ5QJeWA ---- Paloma Morphy With special guest(s) to be announced soon. Where: ZeyZey Miami 353 NE 61 Street Miami, Florida, 33137 When: May 12, 2027 <-- rescheduled date! Doors: 7:00 PM Age: 18+ An Escala Sonora Event Powered by: Mishu --- Miami is set for a captivating night as Paloma Morphy, the rising singer-songwriter from Monterrey, Mexico, brings her emotionally raw and genre-bending sound to ZeyZey on September 30. Fresh off a breakout year that saw her win the 2025 Latin GRAMMY for Best New Artist and earn recognition from Rolling Stone, Apple Music, Spotify, and Billboard as one of the most exciting emerging voices in Latin music, Paloma is redefining modern pop through vulnerability, minimalist production, and striking storytelling. With over 50 million streams on her debut album 'Au' and sold-out shows across Mexico, her live performances feel intimate, honest, and deeply immersive. Don’t miss the chance to experience one of Latin pop’s fastest-rising artists in Miami this fall
